name: devshot/shopware6-devshot
description: Secure DevShot workspace connector for anonymized Shopware maintenance.

description.de-DE: Verbindet Shopware sicher mit DevShot, fordert jede Workspace-Synchronisation per einmaliger Nonce zur Freigabe an und überträgt nur anonymisierte Daten ohne Media oder Secrets.
description.en-GB: Securely connects Shopware to DevShot, requires explicit approval with a one-time nonce for every workspace sync, and transfers only anonymized data without media or secrets.
